# locale — API (React, the parity reference)

Exports: `LocaleProvider`, `useLocale`, `LocaleProviderProps`, `LocaleContextValue`, `MessageKey`, `ZenMessages`

Solid mirrors these props. Vanilla takes the same props as a factory argument
(handle out, `.el` is the node); web-components as `<zen-locale>`-style
attributes/properties. Divergences (Select, Toast, data-driven families) are in
SKILL.md.

### LocaleProvider

- `locale?: string | undefined`
- `currency?: string | undefined`
- `messages?: Partial<ZenMessages> | undefined` — Translations for any of the built-in strings.
- `children?: React.ReactNode`

### LocaleContextValue (type)

- `locale: string | undefined` — BCP 47: "en-IN", "hi-IN", "de-DE". Undefined: the browser's.
- `currency: string | undefined` — ISO 4217 for amounts that do not name their own: "INR".
- `t: (key: MessageKey, values?: Record<string, string | number>) => string` — A built-in string, translated if the app supplied one, filled with `values`.
